correctness.rationale: From f=(3+2 Σ cos(θ_i−θ_j))/9 the drift is c∇f with c=3K/2. Along a greedy arc u=U g/||g||, U=√P, g=∇f and H=Hess f, PMP p=λg (since optimal ball-maximizer equals greedy) and costate p˙=−cHp force λ˙g+λ(2c+U/||g||)Hg=0. Since factor is >0 this requires Hg collinear with g; the symbolic witness violates it. Exact independent SymPy differentiation verified g, Hg and all 3 cross-product components, and real-analytic identity theorem makes nonvanishing open dense. Nearby greedy reachability and convex compact controls ensure attainable minimum; therefore its failure of PMP implies strict time-gap. No global optimal synthesis or remote-target conclusion.
